title: Chasing the Assassin in Darkness
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji tucked the secret letter into his chest, a faint footstep sounded outside the window—someone was watching this room. When he lowered his gaze to the cinnabar seal at the letter's end, his heart already had its answer: the ink's fragrance was identical to the pine ink perpetually burning in the Third Elder's study.

text.content: The night had grown deep. In the servants' quarters at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, candlelight flickered. Chen Ji sat alone before his father's遗物, his fingertips gently brushing across an old wooden box. The box's surface was thick with dust, clearly long unopened. He took a deep breath and slowly pushed the box open—inside were merely ordinary items: several yellowed功法fragments, a lower-grade spiritual stone that had lost its spiritual nature, and a letter folded with meticulous precision.

The letter had been sealed with a special technique, making it impossible for ordinary spiritual sense to probe. Chen Ji's gaze hardened slightly as he gently touched the envelope with the power of the Tianji Record Fragment—an instant later, a faint premonition surged from the depths of his mind. His pupils contracted sharply: this letter contained Heavenly Secrets! At the edge of the envelope, there was a barely perceptible cinnabar seal, like a sleeping serpent's eye, emanating a cryptic aura.

dialogue.content: Father... what did you want me to see?

text.content: Chen Ji broke the seal with his fingertip and unfolded the letter. What met his eyes were characters of bold and powerful strokes, yet beneath the penmanship ran a sense of urgency and determination—this was written by his father on his deathbed. The letter's contents made his spine grow cold. 'Ji'er, if you are reading this letter, your father has likely already passed from this world. The remnants of the Five Elders have not been eliminated—they've secretly colluded with outside forces, intending to use foreign enemies to destroy the Tianqing Sect. In three days, masters will infiltrate the sect, and then with coordination from within, a thorough purge will commence. Father was weak and alone, so I can only leave this warning in this letter...'

The letter trembled slightly between Chen Ji's fingers. His expression remained calm, only the depths of his eyes churned with monstrous waves. Three days. Only three days. He raised his head to gaze at the heavy night beyond the window, his voice cold: 'What a fine coordination from within... the Five Elders' remnants have hidden deeply enough.' The candlelight flickered intermittently, illuminating his expressionless face, yet making him appear even more gloomy and terrifying.

Chen Ji continued reading. The letter detailed his father's生前investigations: the Five Elders' remnants were led by the Third Elder, secretly colluding with a high-ranking figure from the Xuanwu Sect; they planned to bring foreign enemies into the sect during the Sect Competition, using 'Demonic Path attack' as an excuse to launch a purge, eliminating all disciples loyal to the old Sect Master in one sweep. What alarmed him even more was the postscript: 'Ji'er, Father has long known about the Tianji Record. Remember—do not let this thing become your death warrant.'

choice.prompt: Faced with this secret letter revealing a shocking conspiracy, Chen Ji must make a decision within three days. How should he act?

choices.description: Time is short, must race against the clock to investigate the Third Elder's mansion, searching for more substantial evidence.
choices.visible_cost: Exposure risk is extremely high, may alert the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key material evidence, seize the initiative
choices.risk_hint: The Third Elder is extremely scheming, his mansion surely has重重埋伏

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the secret letter close to his body and draped on a black cloak. He did not use the Tianji Record's predictive power—every point of Heavenly Fate was precious, not to be carelessly consumed unless absolutely necessary. He pushed open the door, his gaze sweeping across the sect shrouded in night, and already had a plan in his heart. 'Since there are only three days, then let the outcome be decided in three days.' His form flashed, turning into a shadow as he silently merged into the night.

dialogue.content: Third Elder... tonight, let me see what kind of festering wound lies beneath your old fox's skin.

choices.text: Secretly Arrange, Wait for the Right Moment
choices.description: Don't alert the enemy, use the废物persona as cover, secretly weave an intelligence network, waiting for the optimal moment to strike.
choices.visible_cost: Time is short, whether evidence can be found within three days is doubtful
choices.risk_hint: If the enemy acts first, the situation will become extremely passive

text.content: Chen Ji carefully folded the secret letter and tucked it into his chest. He slowly closed his eyes, his mind racing through various possibilities. 'Three days... if I act rashly, I'll only fall into their trap.' He opened his eyes, cold light flashing within: 'Let them make the first move. I want to see, in this chess game, who is the hunter and who is the prey.' With that, he relit a calming incense, letting his aura completely settle, as if merely a sleeping废物disciple.

dialogue.content: Father, rest assured. This blood debt, your son has recorded it.

choices.description: Su Qingyao is the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, capable and motivated to intervene in this matter. Perhaps her strength can be leveraged to jointly face the crisis.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing one's strength may arouse even greater suspicion from Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful ally, greatly expanding intelligence channels
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao is extremely suspicious, having come close to the truth three times; must respond with caution

text.content: Chen Ji contemplated momentarily, then picked up his pen to write a note. The note contained only a few sparse words, yet each one was shocking: 'In three days, the sect will change. At the Zi hour, meet under the old locust tree at the Back Mountain.' He sent the note using the spirit crane method, watching the spiritual light fade into the night, his eyes flickering with a complex expression. 'Su Qingyao... if you truly serve the sect, then you share a common enemy with me.'

dialogue.content: I hope you aren't the next one of the Five Elders.

text.content: Just then, Chen Ji's gaze fell upon the cinnabar seal at the end of the letter. The seal bore a bagua pattern, with a vertical pupil at its center—remarkably similar to the cover design of the Tianji Record. His heart stirred. Bringing the paper close to his nose, a faint pine ink fragrance wafted up. This scent... he had encountered it somewhere before. Memory surged like a tide—the pine ink that perpetually burned in the Third Elder's study! Throughout the entire Tianqing Sect, only that Third Elder favored this particular ink, claiming it aided in spiritual concentration.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his gaze turning ice-cold. 'What a fine Third Elder... Father, are you telling me the secret letter originated from here?' Flipping the paper over, he indeed discovered a faint ink trace—the unintentional drag of a pen tip left by the writer. Upon careful examination, the ink's shade and direction matched precisely the Third Elder's typical calligraphic style. His father must have uncovered this connection before his death, deliberately embedding the cinnabar seal in the letter as a clue. And that vertical pupil pattern on the seal... its connection to the Tianji Record seemed far more intricate than he had initially imagined.

dialogue.content: The vertical pupil... that is the mark of the Heavenly Eye. Its circulation within the Tianqing Sect proves the Third Elder's connection to that thing runs far deeper than you imagined.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul quivered within the Tianji Record Fragment, his voice carrying a rare weight of gravity: 'Boy, your father... he was someone who knew the true origins of the Tianji Record. Leaving you this letter was probably not merely to warn you of the sect's crisis.' Chen Ji frowned at these words. He suddenly recalled the phrase in the letter—'do not let this become your death sentence'—how much had his father truly known? And why had he specifically cautioned Chen Ji about this? Outside the window, the night wind suddenly rose, rattling the window lattice. Chen Ji tightly gripped the secret letter in his hand, his knuckles white.

He stood up, walked to the window, and gazed toward the direction of the Third Elder's mansion in the distance. There, lanterns blazed brightly, and the silhouettes of patrolling disciples could be vaguely seen. 'Third Elder... just how grand a chess match are you orchestrating?' He murmured to himself, yet another figure inevitably surfaced in his mind—his sister, Chen Nian, whom he had personally sent to the Holy Sect. Had she too been drawn into this chess game? At this thought, the killing intent in Chen Ji's eyes nearly solidified into实质. 'Regardless of what kind of chess game you have set up... I will dismantle it piece by piece for you to see.'

choice.prompt: After careful deliberation, Chen Ji decided to first investigate the connection between the secret letter and the Third Elder's mansion. How does he intend to act?

choices.description: Directly infiltrate the mansion, searching for the pine ink source or other material evidence. Highest risk, but potential for greatest gains.
choices.visible_cost: Once discovered, all previous disguise will be destroyed
choices.visible_reward: May discover the original secret letter or other key evidence
choices.risk_hint: There must be powerful experts guarding the Third Elder's mansion, with extremely high danger coefficient

text.content: Chen Ji changed into a set of dark combat attire, concealing the Tianji Record Fragment close to his body. His toes lightly touched the ground as his figure glided out of the room like a ghost. The Third Elder's mansion was located in the sect's core area, normally heavily guarded. But tonight seemed different—the patrolling disciples were notably fewer than usual, and a fixed gap appeared every incense stick's duration. 'Someone is secretly arranging this...' Chen Ji coldly thought in his heart, 'It seems tonight, someone inside the mansion is also restless.' He seized the opportunity, slipping over the high wall like a wisp of smoke, silently falling into the mansion.

dialogue.content: Since you show no righteousness, don't blame me for playing unfairly.

choices.text: Search for the pine ink source
choices.description: First investigate the pine ink suppliers from the periphery, establishing the connection between the Third Elder and the secret letter from a physical evidence perspective.
choices.visible_cost: Takes a long time, possibly missing the best opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Obtain ironclad evidence, not easily refuted by excuses
choices.risk_hint: If the other party destroys the evidence, all previous efforts will be wasted

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush into action. Instead, he visited the sect's杂物堂 through the night. With his Servant Disciple identity,出入 these places was perfectly normal. In the杂物堂's record book, he found the monthly pine ink requisition list for the Third Elder's mansion—quantities, specifications, suppliers, all documented in detail. And the supplier's name was赫然 a shop in the city with close business dealings with the Xuanwu Sect. 'As expected... the Third Elder's forces have already extended beyond the sect.' He silently recorded this discovery, his expression growing increasingly grim.

dialogue.content: The evidence chain is gradually becoming clear. Next... it should be your turn to taste the feeling of being schemed against.

choices.text: Using the Tianji Record to predict
choices.description: Risk using the Tianji Record to foresee what will happen in the Third Elder's residence, obtaining crucial intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: Each use consumes 5 Heavenly Fate points; Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate is nearly depleted
choices.visible_reward: Obtain precise intelligence, knowing the opponent's next move
choices.risk_hint: Low Heavenly Fate may lead to unpredictable consequences

text.content:
Chen Ji sat cross-legged, slowly unfolding the Tianji Record Fragment. A faint golden light emerged from the pages, and an arcane, unfathomable aura diffused outward.

He closed his eyes in concentration, his consciousness sinking into the endless starry sea. After three breaths, a blurred image materialized in his mind—

The Third Elder's residence, rear courtyard secret chamber.

A figure in black robes was conversing privately with the Third Elder. The black-robed figure turned, their face shrouded in black mist, only revealing a pair of purple-glowing eyes.

"...Three days from now, strike on time."

The black-robed figure's voice was hoarse and icy cold. "The Holy Sect has already made arrangements, we only need to coordinate from within and without."

dialogue.content: Holy Sect... so that's it. The backing of the Five Elders' remnants, it turns out to be the Holy Sect!

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, cold sweat beading on his forehead. Though the Tianji Record's prediction was blurry, it had already revealed crucial information—the external force the Third Elder colluded with was the Holy Sect!

Recalling that his sister Chen Nian had been taken away by the Holy Sect, his fists clenched tightly, fingernails digging deep into his palms.

"Holy Sect... Chen Nian..."

He took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. The most urgent matter now was to stop the Third Elder's scheme; saving his sister could only be planned carefully later.

"Three days... I must find irrefutable evidence within these three days, otherwise the entire Tianqing Sect will become lambs waiting to be slaughtered."

He walked to the desk, spreading out a piece of white paper, writing down the clues he had obtained one by one: the Third Elder, Xuanwu Sect, Holy Sect, Five Elders' remnants... these seemingly independent forces were actually weaving a large net.

And the center of the net was precisely the Tianqing Sect.

"What they want is not simply to destroy the Tianqing Sect..." Chen Ji murmured to himself, a sharp light flickering in his eyes, "What they want is the Tianji Record."

The line from his father's letter, 'Don't let this item become your death warrant,' now carried profound meaning. The secret of the Tianji Record must have been learned by outsiders. Otherwise, why would the Holy Sect act at this moment?

He burned the white paper, watching the dancing flames, his killing intent burning ever more fiercely.

choice.prompt: After thorough investigation, Chen Ji has obtained clues to crucial evidence. Now he must make a choice before the deadline.

choices.description: Present the secret letter and evidence to the old Sect Master Ling Yuan, using the sect's power to eliminate the Third Elder's faction.
choices.visible_cost: The old Sect Master's relationship with the Third Elder is unclear; he may instead be taken advantage of
choices.visible_reward: Fully justified, using sect forces to eliminate all enemies in one sweep
choices.risk_hint: Whether Ling Yuan can be trusted remains an unknown

text.content:
Chen Ji organized the secret letter, Servants' Quarters records, and clues obtained from the Tianji Record prediction into a detailed memorial.

He sought an audience with the old Sect Master Ling Yuan that very night.

Unexpectedly, Ling Yuan had not yet gone to sleep, as if he had been waiting for something. After hearing Chen Ji's report, the old man's turbid eyes suddenly blazed with brilliant light.

"Good! Good! Good!" Ling Yuan repeated 'good' three times, slapping the table and rising, "I've long suspected Third Brother had problems, just never had concrete evidence. Now that proof is solid..."

He looked at Chen Ji with a deeper, meaningful scrutiny: "This child actually has some of your father's bearing from back then."

dialogue.content: "Three days from now? That's too rushed. Why not... turn the tide?"

choices.description: Don't alert anyone; when the Third Elder acts, invite the enemy into a trap, eliminating all traitors in one net.
choices.visible_cost: If the plan fails, face encirclement and attacks from multiple forces alone
choices.visible_reward: Expose the traitors' crimes to the world, killing two birds with one stone
choices.risk_hint: Requires precise timing control; any slight misstep leads to total failure

text.content:
Chen Ji declined Ling Yuan's proposal, bowing and saying: "Sect Master, this matter still requires careful planning. This disciple believes we should turn the tide—let them think their plan is proceeding smoothly, then catch the turtles in a jar when the external enemies enter our territory."

Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, studying the "waste" disciple before him, then suddenly laughed: "You boy, you've been hiding deep enough."

Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained calm: "This disciple only has the sect's interests at heart."

"Good." Ling Yuan nodded. "I'll give you three days. After three days, everything will be under your command."

Walking out of the Sect Master's residence, Chen Ji's back was already soaked with cold sweat. He knew his disguise... had already cracked.

dialogue.content: Third Elder, this chess game of yours... it's my turn now.

text.content:
After leaving the Sect Master's residence, Chen Ji did not return directly to the Servants' Quarters, but took a detour to the Rear Mountain. Moonlight was like water, splashing on the jagged rocks, casting cold, clear shadows.

He stopped beside a large boulder, taking out his father's testament letter from his chest, staring at the vermillion seal. The vertical pupil pattern glowed with an eerie red light under the moonlight, like a sleeping eye that could open at any moment.

"Father... what exactly did you experience?"

He murmured softly, fingertips gently stroking the seal. Just then, an inexplicable fluctuation emanated from the seal. Chen Ji felt his vision blur, and a fragmentary image actually surfaced in his mind—

In the scene, a young man confronted a black-robed figure. The man was handsome, with features bearing a striking resemblance to Chen Ji - it was his father, Chen Xuan, in his youth!

"The Tianji Record is not your private property!" the black-robed figure thundered. "It belongs to the Heavenly Way, to the 'Eye'!"

"Belongs to the Heavenly Way?" Chen Xuan冷笑" (cold laugh). "That's merely a lie you fabricated. The Tianji Record chose me, which proves it has its own will. And your 'Heavenly Eye'... is nothing but an executioner seeking to enslave the mortal realm!"

Enraged, the black-robed figure raised his hand and fired a beam of purple light. The scene ended abruptly.

dialogue.content: "That black-robed figure... was the Heavenly Eye Messenger of the previous generation." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly emerged, carrying a rare heaviness. "Your father paid an enormous price to seal his power back then. And that cinnabar mark on your hand... is precisely the product of that sealing ritual."

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart convulsed at these words. He lowered his gaze to that vertical pupil mark, and suddenly discovered that the pupil at its center had trembled slightly - as if something slumbered within.

"Father... what have you left for me?"

He took a deep breath and carefully secured the testament letter. Regardless, the most urgent matter now was dealing with the crisis in three days. As for the secrets hidden within this mark... that would have to wait for another day.

In the distance, the east was already tinged with the white of dawn. A new day was about to arrive, and his decisive battle with the Third Elder had officially begun.

Just as Chen Ji tucked the secret letter into his怀中的瞬间, a extremely light footstep came from outside the window - someone was monitoring this room.

Chen Ji's gaze sharpened, but he made no movement. He slowly walked to the window and peered through the crack into the darkness outside. Under the moonlight, a blurry figure stood among the nearby shadows, seemingly窥探着什么.

He coldly smiled in his heart: "They came quickly enough... It seems the Third Elder has already become vigilant."

What startled him even more was that when he lowered his head to glance again at the cinnabar mark at the end of the secret letter, a familiar aura struck him. The ink's fragrance was identical to the pine ink that perpetually burned in the Third Elder's study -
The answer, ready to emerge.
